onCreated and actual reload read through the real read service into own sessionStorage ledger only
Programmatic submit cases explicitly bypass native validity/disabled UI; positive controls click enabled submit
Historical overlay changes only exact-base dialog bytes; current shared schema and services stay active
Headless local Edge only; no physical device or Safari/WebKit acceptance
cleanup: Own contexts/browser/loopback server closed; immutable receipts and own cache retained; no DB/shared-resource cleanup
